data.title: 丰川祥子 · Ave Mujica 的黑蓝花嫁
data.description: 祥子穿着黑蓝色婚礼礼服坐在钢琴旁，羽毛半面具放在捧花边；她轻触琴键弹出一段克制旋律，抬眼面对镜头时，舞台上的高贵与卸下面具后的真心同时出现。
data.action: 后台钢琴旁弹完克制旋律抬眼，舞台高贵与卸下面具后的真心同时出现
data.lighting: blue stage lamps with a warm piano rim light
data.mood: 把面具放下的音乐花嫁
data.promptProse: Sakiko looks toward the viewer, hands on the piano keys and removed mask beside her bouquet; blue stage light rims her veil, warmer light tracing the piano.
data.animaCaption: Her hands rest on the piano keys, removed feather mask beside the bouquet.
